start.description: Start an idempotent background service through FluentCI’s native workspace service manager and wait for readiness.

project.description: Workspace directory used by every native service manager call. Default: ".".

name.description: Full service name, default module-aws-emulator-default; must start with module-aws-emulator- to scope lifecycle operations.

version.description: Docker image version tag. Uses the profile default when omitted; cannot be combined with image.

image.description: Full Docker image reference, including an optional digest; replaces the default repository and version.

port.description: Host port for the primary endpoint; zero allocates an available loopback port. AWS Emulator uses the same nonzero port inside and outside its container. Default: 9297.

ports.description: Comma-separated container ports or HOST:CONTAINER bindings. Omit for every profile port with random host bindings. Include the primary port once.

volumes.description: Comma-separated /CONTAINER_PATH anonymous volumes or SOURCE:/CONTAINER_PATH[:ro|rw] mounts. Explicit named/bind data survives stop.

env.description: Comma-separated KEY=VALUE test configuration overrides; no JSON object. Use disposable test values because definitions are sent to the manager.

command.description: Comma-separated foreground command tokens replacing the image command; literal argv, with no shell expansion.

dependsOn.description: Comma-separated existing native service names whose readiness must be satisfied before startup.

startupTimeoutMs.description: Readiness deadline, from 100 to 600000 milliseconds; defaults to the service profile.

stopTimeoutMs.description: Graceful shutdown deadline from 100 to 120000 milliseconds. Default: 5000.

restartPolicy.description: Native restart policy: never, on_failure or always. Default: "never". Allowed values: never, on_failure, always.

maxRestarts.description: Maximum automatic restarts, from zero to 100. Default: 0.

healthCheck.description: Keep running the readiness probe as the native recurring health check. Default: true.

readinessCommand.description: Comma-separated literal probe command run inside the owned container; overrides the profile probe.

readinessPath.description: HTTP readiness URL path for profiles using an HTTP probe.

stateDir.description: Required absolute host directory holding generated credentials and TLS files. Mounted into the emulator and never deleted by stop.

stop.description: Stop only this named service through the native manager; preserve explicitly mounted data. Native dependents are stopped too.

project.description: Workspace directory used by every native service manager call. Default: ".".

name.description: Full service name, default module-aws-emulator-default; must start with module-aws-emulator- to scope lifecycle operations.

restart.description: Restart the existing native service definition and wait for readiness.

project.description: Workspace directory used by every native service manager call. Default: ".".

name.description: Full service name, default module-aws-emulator-default; must start with module-aws-emulator- to scope lifecycle operations.

status.description: Return the service’s native lifecycle state and actual loopback port bindings.

project.description: Workspace directory used by every native service manager call. Default: ".".

name.description: Full service name, default module-aws-emulator-default; must start with module-aws-emulator- to scope lifecycle operations.

logs.description: Read native service logs; optionally follow new output until interrupted, without starting or stopping a service.

project.description: Workspace directory used by every native service manager call. Default: ".".

name.description: Full service name, default module-aws-emulator-default; must start with module-aws-emulator- to scope lifecycle operations.

tail.description: Maximum recent log lines, from 1 to 10000, before optional live output. Default: 100.

follow.description: Stream new native service logs until interrupted. Default false returns a bounded snapshot. Interrupting logs leaves the background service running. Default: false.

build.description: Build the official AWS Emulator package into a local Docker image without starting it.

project.description: Workspace directory used by every native service manager call. Default: ".".

image.description: Local image name/tag to build. Default: "fluentci/aws-emulator:local".

architecture.description: RPM architecture; auto uses the Docker daemon architecture. Default: "auto". Allowed values: auto, x86_64, aarch64.

packageUrl.description: Optional HTTPS URL of a pinned official AWS Emulator RPM; requires packageSha256. Default uses the official latest LTS package.

packageSha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 for a pinned RPM; custom URLs require it.

timeoutMs.description: Image build deadline from 1000 to 3600000 milliseconds. Default: 1800000.

setup.description: Configure a Cachix cache using host credentials.

cache.description: Cachix cache name; credentials come from CACHIX_AUTH_TOKEN.

setup.body:
present <- P.hasEnv "CACHIX_AUTH_TOKEN" >>= unwrap
  token <- if present then P.getEnv "CACHIX_AUTH_TOKEN" >>= unwrap else pure ""
  Native.setupWithSetup (Dependencies.ensureFor "nix") args.cache
  pure { enabled: trim token /= "", cache: args.cache }

push.description: Push the result closure to a Cachix cache using host credentials.

cache.description: Cachix cache name; credentials come from CACHIX_AUTH_TOKEN.

push.body:
present <- P.hasEnv "CACHIX_AUTH_TOKEN" >>= unwrap
  token <- if present then P.getEnv "CACHIX_AUTH_TOKEN" >>= unwrap else pure ""
  Native.pushResultWithSetup (Dependencies.ensureFor "nix") args.cache
  pure { enabled: trim token /= "", cache: args.cache }

send.description: Send one Discord notification through curl and verify its delivery acknowledgement. Credentials come from the host environment.

message.description: Notification text, passed literally and JSON-encoded internally. Maximum 2000 Unicode characters; no JSON object is accepted.

webhookEnv.description: Name of the host environment variable holding the credential; pass the variable name, never the secret URL or token. Default: "DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL".

timeoutSeconds.description: HTTP request timeout in seconds, from 1 to 600. Notifications are sent once without automatic retries. Default: 30.

username.description: Optional webhook display name, from 1 to 80 Unicode characters.

avatarUrl.description: Optional HTTPS image URL overriding the webhook avatar.

threadId.description: Positive numeric Discord thread ID; required for existing forum/media channel threads.

allowMentions.description: Allow user, role and everyone mentions explicitly. The default disables all parsed mentions. Default: false.

send.returned: { provider :: String, sent :: Boolean, httpStatus :: Int, messageId :: String }

upload.description: Upload Linux packages to Gemfury using credentials from the host environment.

files.description: Required comma-separated package paths. Whitespace is trimmed; CSV quotes preserve commas inside a filename. Empty lists and malformed entries are rejected.

upload.body:
files <- Native.decodeFiles args.files
  present <- P.hasEnv "FURY_TOKEN" >>= unwrap
  token <- if present then P.getEnv "FURY_TOKEN" >>= unwrap else pure ""
  Native.uploadFilesWithSetup (Dependencies.ensureFor "curl") files
  pure { uploaded: trim token /= "", files }

unwrap :: forall a. P.Result a -> Effect a

setup.description: Install Java (21 by default) through setup-java, verify Android command-line tools, install selected SDK packages, and publish their environment.

version.description: Pinned Google command-line tools archive build ID; nondefault builds require archiveUrl and archiveSha256. Default: "15859902".

javaVersion.description: Java release or supported selector forwarded to the typed setup-java dependency; defaults to Java 21. Default: "21".

sdkRoot.description: Absolute SDK root; defaults to a per-user directory keyed by the command-line tools build.

packages.description: Comma-separated native Android SDK package IDs, such as platform-tools,platforms;android-36,build-tools;36.0.0. Blank installs no packages through this field. Default: "platform-tools".

apiLevels.description: Comma-separated API levels or preview names; installs platforms;android-VALUE for each entry.

buildToolsVersions.description: Comma-separated Android build-tools revisions to install and add to PATH.

ndkVersions.description: Comma-separated side-by-side NDK revisions to install; ANDROID_NDK_HOME selects the first.

cmakeVersions.description: Comma-separated SDK CMake revisions to install and add to PATH.

systemImages.description: Comma-separated complete system-image package IDs; no emulator or virtual device is started.

packageFile.description: Existing file of newline-separated SDK package IDs, passed to sdkmanager.

channel.description: Highest SDK repository channel to include: 0 stable, 1 beta, 2 dev, or 3 canary. Default: 0.

acceptLicenses.description: Accept SDK licenses noninteractively. False uses existing licenses and closed stdin; missing licenses fail installation. Default: true.

proxyType.description: SDK proxy protocol: http or socks; requires proxyHost and proxyPort.

proxyHost.description: SDK repository proxy hostname or IP address.

proxyPort.description: SDK proxy port from 1 to 65535 when a proxy is enabled.

sdkManagerArgs.description: Additional literal sdkmanager option/value tokens as comma-separated text; cannot change the managed operation or SDK root.

archiveUrl.description: Optional HTTPS command-line tools ZIP URL for mirrors or alternate builds; requires archiveSha256.

archiveSha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 of the alternate ZIP. Default Google downloads use pinned platform checksums.

setup.returned: { tool :: String, version :: String, binDir :: String, environment :: Array Contract.Variable, sdkRoot :: String, javaVersion :: String, commandLineToolsBuild :: String }

send.description: Send one Telegram notification through curl and verify its delivery acknowledgement. Credentials come from the host environment.

message.description: Notification text, passed literally and JSON-encoded internally. Maximum 4096 Unicode characters; no JSON object is accepted.

tokenEnv.description: Name of the host environment variable holding the credential; pass the variable name, never the secret URL or token. Default: "TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN".

timeoutSeconds.description: HTTP request timeout in seconds, from 1 to 600. Notifications are sent once without automatic retries. Default: 30.

chatId.description: Nonzero numeric Telegram chat ID (including negative group IDs), or an @channel username.

parseMode.description: Optional Telegram formatting mode; omitted text is plain. Escape markup according to the selected mode. Allowed values: HTML, MarkdownV2, Markdown.

messageThreadId.description: Optional positive forum topic message-thread ID.

protectContent.description: Protect the message from forwarding and saving when true.
